description: Middleware admin only: submit a middleware transaction using action/input from middleware_get_capabilities. For account actions the selected enabled middleware account is used. For domain actions supply the middleware domain_id. Choose account_id from middleware_get_capabilities when several accounts are enabled. Every submission needs a stable idempotency_key: retry an identical request with the SAME key. 202/queued means accepted, not completed; poll middleware_get_transaction. Paid or destructive actions require explicit user intent. These operator orders do not use the ConnectReseller customer wallet or local domain portfolio.
name: middleware_submit_transaction
